title: Ferry Island Campground

services.name: Ferry Island Campground
services.desc: is a municipal campground composed of 103 campsites and conveniently located 3.5 km from downtown Terrace. This campground is surrounded by a 150-acre park that includes trails, a children's playground, and unique tree carvings! Ferry Island Campground is open May to September, however, Ferry Island is open to walkers and river watchers year-round. Ferry Island has both on- and off-leash dog areas. Dogs can be off leash south of the power lines and must be on-leash, year-round, north of the power lines, including in the parking lots, and in the campground and playground area. services.name: Course Description
services.desc: Come learn the great game of hockey! Perfect for beginners learning the fundamentals of skating, passing, and shooting through drills and games. This program is aimed for adults who are wanting to learn how to play hockey in a stress free and welcoming environment. Full equipment is required. This program is designed for players who have already completed Intro to Hockey - Level 1 (or have similar experience) and are ready for the next step in their development. Level 2 focuses more on skill development and game awareness-building confidence in real hockey scenarios. Full equipment is required.
